faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.heading: How do you implement AI in a business?

items.q: How can I implement AI in my business?
items.a: We start with an audit: we look at where the hours go and where customers are lost (unanswered calls, enquiries left hanging, tasks repeated every day). That produces a prioritised proposal covering what to automate first and what impact to expect. Then we build it and leave it running in production, with follow-up.

items.q: How much does it cost to implement AI in a company?
items.a: It depends on the scope, so we do not quote a fixed price without seeing your case. What we do is start with the audit and put a proposal in front of you, with the cost and the expected return, before you commit to anything.

items.q: What AI solutions can a company like mine actually use?
items.a: Three are the most common: phone agents that answer calls 24/7 and book or screen them, chatbots that reply instantly and qualify contacts, and automations that remove repetitive tasks. We work with hospitality, tourism, industry, consulting, accommodation and events.

items.q: Do I need to be a large company or have a technical team?
items.a: No. Most of our clients are small and medium businesses with no IT department. We set it up, connect it and maintain it; you just tell us how your business works.

items.q: Is AI going to replace my team?
items.a: That is not the point. What we take off their plate is the repetitive part: answering the same thing twenty times, moving data between systems, covering out of hours. Your team keeps the work that needs judgement.

items.q: Does it work in several languages?
items.a: Yes. We have agents in production handling Catalan, Spanish, English and French, detecting the language someone writes in and replying in theirs.

items.q: What happens to my customers’ data?
items.a: We define from the start what data is processed, where it is stored and who has access. We work in line with GDPR and only with the information needed to deliver the service.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This page explains how 9bit uses cookies on this website.
cookies.section_what_body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They help the website remember information about your visit.
cookies.section_use_body: We use essential cookies to make the site function (language preference, consent state) and optional analytics cookies to understand how visitors use the site. We do not sell or share data with third parties for advertising.
cookies.section_essential: Essential — required for the site to work (consent state, locale).
cookies.section_analytics: Analytics — anonymous usage data, only after you accept.
cookies.section_manage_body: You can clear cookies in your browser settings at any time. Rejecting non-essential cookies will limit analytics but will not affect site functionality.
cookies.section_contact_body: Questions about this policy? Email hola@9-bit.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
